summary.name: Voxel Art
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: figures and spaces are built from cubes of one consistent voxel size. Stepped contours, controlled light and color blocks establish depth. Voxel art is distinct from pixel art, and a pixel texture on an arbitrary mesh is not voxel geometry.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: block-built characters and worlds, used alone. Explicit hybrids: strict isometric system overviews, game tours and infrastructure explainers, and unit-based volume or capacity comparisons. Inferred: miniature or diorama-style scenes, since the catalog lists Voxel Art as compatible with dolly and orbit camera motions.
summary.limitations: Explicit: keep one voxel size everywhere and keep parallel edges parallel. Avoid perspective shrinkage, free camera spin and pixel textures on non-voxel meshes. Rounded or scaled voxels must not misrepresent quantities, and data must not be invented. Simulated physics is unvalidated unless verified, and simulated appearance is not evidence of physical production.
summary.palette: Suggested, not approved: background #EEE9DB for the dominant layout ground, foreground #30444C for text and ink, accent_1 #63928D (teal), accent_2 #C0845D (terracotta). Base count is four and gradients are disabled. Foreground on background contrast is 8.418. Accent fills are decorative only, at 2.93 and 3.257 against foreground text. Task colors override these tokens.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: use smooth authored movement where it helps, and keep deliberate cuts, impacts, constant-speed sections and reading holds without forcing easing everywhere. Animate complete forms or purposeful block assembly while preserving scale. Video state derives from composition time. Live hover or scroll belongs only to interactive delivery. Orbit needs complete geometry or turntable views, and dolly needs real depth.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style: no mandatory music, genre, tempo, instrument, voice or audio layer is assigned. Choose music, voiceover, effects, ambience or silence from topic, audience and storyboard. Explicit audio requirements and supplied assets take priority. Keep speech intelligible, avoid competing vocals, and state assumptions. Inferred: a restrained sound accent may suit purposeful block assembly.
summary.assetRequirements: Unspecified: no fixed asset list is provided. Required inputs include exact copy, supplied colors or artwork, and local fonts loaded before rendering. Cube geometry comes from instances of one size. Optional assets include creature or character layers for parallax, a complete 3D model or captured turntable views for orbit, and exported tldraw diagram assets. Missing assets must be stated.
summary.combinations: Explicit hybrid style-077: orthographic isometric camera with equal voxel sizes across depth, axis-aligned block groups and 2D labels. Explicit hybrid style-097: unit counts where one voxel equals one stated unit, teal and terracotta mark two categories, and scales start at zero. Avoid combinations that add perspective shrinkage or free spin to isometric scenes.
summary.productionApproach: Explicit style renderer: Three.js with InstancedMesh for cube construction, plus ShaderMaterial where needed. Motion engine: GSAP paused timeline driven by composition time, with one owner per property. Default pipeline: HyperFrames for composition and export. Remotion is fallback only if HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists. chroma-js is optional for palette checks.
